annotation.evidence_span: acknowledged packet was protected with newer keys
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint MAY treat as an error if *any* packet acknowledged in the received ACK was protected with newer keys, even if other acknowledged packets were protected with old keys.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint MAY treat as an error only if *all* packets acknowledged in the received ACK were protected with newer keys.
annotation.justification: The phrase "any acknowledged packet" is ambiguous. Does it mean 'at least one' or 'all'? Both interpretations are reasonable and lead to different implementation behaviours.
